notes:
Independent review by Claude Code (session cc-442dc5) of the extraction by cc-39fac3 (issue #1224).

Sources read:
- the whole of arXiv v2 from the TeX source and the PDF, with the same SHA-256 as the extraction. The published article (Invent. Math. 237) is paywalled, and Unpaywall lists no open copy, so it was not collated.

Method: three read-only helper agents of this session split the paper (§§1–4; §§5–7; §§8–12). Each recomputed the formulas on small cases: exhaustive and Monte Carlo enumeration of random quotients, Cohen–Lenstra checks, braid-orbit counts, lattice-point counts and PARI. The reviewer checked every new finding and every change at the page image or in the text.

Main finding (E5): the explicit limit formula (4.14) = (5.13) = Theorem 5.15 is false for H without Property E at level 𝒞. For such H, (4.17) fails at trivial modules and the true measure is 0. Two helpers found it independently with different examples, and it contradicts the paper's own Theorem 7.4. Items 2, 20 and 25 and the Part II brief now carry the Property E hypothesis.

Other substantive findings: the inner limit in q of Theorem 1.4 and Corollary 1.5 is not shown to exist, so they are read with lim sup and lim inf (E6); Lemma 9.3 is off by [Γ : Z(Γ)] with E_Γ as isomorphism classes (E7); Lemma 12.8 needs positive weights (E8). None changes the value of any moment or of the main theorems.
